title: Synthesis of novel macrocyclic di‐ and tetralactams containing triazole subunits
abstract: AbstractThe new macrocyclic di‐ and tetralactams 9, 15, and 16 were obtained in 16–24% yields by heating the appropriate bis‐amines 7 or 8 with the corresponding bisaldehyde 5 or 14 in refluxing acetic acid under high‐dilution conditions. © 2003 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Heteroatom Chem 14:551–559, 2003; Published online in Wiley InterScience (www.interscience.wiley.com). DOI 10.1002/hc.10191
